bsw: bsw — Besu, the first element of the name of the right leg; perhaps from bs "bring in, introduce", but written with a fish classifier and not understood (name element; reading uncertain; Budge: besu "traveller")
m-bꜣḥ: m-bꜣḥ — before, in the presence of (compound preposition: m "in" + bꜣḥ "presence")
mnw: mnw — Min, the ithyphallic god of fertility and of the desert roads, lord of Coptos and Akhmim (god's name; Budge: Àmsu)
wnmi: wnmi — right, on the right-hand side (adjective; written with the sign of the West)
wnpt: wnpt — a feminine noun written with the wood classifier, perhaps a wooden object; not otherwise known (noun; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: un pet "grief")
nbt-ḥwt: nbt-ḥwt — Nephthys, "Lady of the Mansion", sister of Isis, Osiris and Seth, a mourner of Osiris (goddess's name; Budge: Nebt-ḥet)
iꜣbi: iꜣbi — left, on the left-hand side (adjective; written with the sign of the East)
ḫnd: ḫnd — to tread, step, walk (on) (verb; ḫnd ḥr "tread upon")
nn: nn — not (negative particle; nn sḏm·f "he will not hear"; nn with a sentence without a verb "there is not, … is not")
smi: smi — to report, announce, make known (verb; infinitive smit)
tw: tw — you (2nd person masculine singular dependent pronoun; object of a verb, or subject after mk)
iry-ꜥꜣ: iry-ꜥꜣ — doorkeeper, porter (noun; lit. "the one belonging to the door": iry + ꜥꜣ "door, door-leaf")
tn: tn — this (feminine demonstrative, after its noun; older spelling ṯn)
n-is: n-is — unless, except (n "not" + the enclitic particle is; before a sḏm·n·f, "unless you have …")
siꜣ: siꜣ — to perceive, recognise, discern (verb); Sia, the god of perception
ḏꜥr: ḏꜥr — to search out, investigate, examine (verb)
ẖt: ẖt — belly, body; the innermost self (noun)
nm: nm — who? (interrogative pronoun; later also written with ꜥ, nim)
wnwt: wnwt — hour (noun; written with the star and the sun)
mꜣw: mꜣw — Mau(?), a title of Thoth, "he of the Two Lands"; the first sign is unclear in the print and the reading is a guess (title; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: māau "recorder")
pty: pty — who? what? (interrogative pronoun; pty tr "who/what then?")
tr: tr — then, now (enclitic particle, strengthening a question)
sw: sw — he, him, it (3rd person masculine singular dependent pronoun)
ḏḥwty: ḏḥwty — Thoth, the ibis god of writing, reckoning and wisdom, recorder of the judgement of the dead (god's name; Budge: Teḥuti)
pw: pw — this; in nominal sentences "it is" (A pw "it is A") (demonstrative)
mi: mi — come! (imperative of iwi "come"; later spelled with ꜥ)
ḫrt: ḫrt — condition, state, affairs; what belongs to one (noun)
wꜥb: wꜥb — to be pure, clean; to purify (verb); pure (adjective)
ḫww: ḫww — evil, wrongdoing (noun; written with the bird of bad things)
ḫwi: ḫwi — to protect, guard, keep safe (verb)
šnt: šnt — hostility, harmful acts, strife (noun; cf. šnṯ "revile, quarrel"; reading uncertain; Budge: śentet)
twi: twi — I, me (1st person singular pronoun; later form of the dependent wi)
m-m: m-m — among, in the midst of (compound preposition; later spelled with ꜥ)
inb: inb — wall (noun; plural inbw, also inbwt)
·s: ·s — she, her, its (3rd person feminine singular suffix pronoun; the folded cloth or the bolt)
iꜥrt: iꜥrt — uraeus, the rearing cobra on the brow of gods and kings (noun; plural iꜥrwt)
wy: wy — a word for a body of water, written with water, pool and canal classifiers; not identified (noun; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: ui "lake")
sbi: sbi — to go, pass, travel (verb; participle sby "one who passes")
wḏꜣ: wḏꜣ — to proceed, go on, set out (verb)
t: t — bread, loaf (noun; later also written tꜣ)
wḏꜣt: wḏꜣt — the wedjat, the Sound Eye of Horus, made whole after Seth tore it; the type of every offering (noun)
sḏm·tw·f: sḏm·tw·f — the tw of the sḏm·tw·f, the passive or impersonal form ("one …", "… is done") (verb form; written after the verb, before its suffix)
